report.explanation: Alert shows all 12 checkout observations returning 200 with durations 47-297ms; no errors. Traces show successful order/checkout spans with healthy postgres pool (size 1, idle 1) and memory retention well under limit. Metrics show /v1/checkout 200 count with 502 count 0, though p95 latency is 412ms. No evidence establishes any taxonomy cause; logs were excluded. Insufficient to bound a root cause.
